notes.title: New Game Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce that I've just released my latest game, Loot Express Delivery Service! It's a 2D pixel art game where you take on the role of a commander, tasked with retrieving valuable items from a distant planet. With challenging missions and a focus on strategy, you'll guide your company to prosperity.

If you enjoyed my previous game, I invite you to check out Loot Express Delivery Service. It's a great opportunity to experience a new adventure and see how my game development skills have progressed.

Thank you for your continued support, and I hope you enjoy Loot Express Delivery Service as much as I enjoyed creating it!
